snippet.title: Banjo: Recompiled Release Trailer (Banjo-Kazooie PC Port!)
snippet.description:
Play Banjo-Kazooie natively on PC! Download here for Windows, Linux, or Mac: https://github.com/BanjoRecomp/BanjoRecomp/releases/latest
Project does not include game assets. Original game is required to play.

For more details about this project, check out the full explanation at https://github.com/BanjoRecomp/BanjoRecomp
For more details about the main tool that was used to make this project, check out https://github.com/N64Recomp/N64Recomp

Thank you to Family Jules for allowing the use of his music! For more of his covers and songs, check out his channel at @FamilyJules7X.

Thank you to Reonu for creating the trailer! Consider checking out his channel at @Reonu!
